clips.title: The story
paras: Tainted bracers lie on the coast of Silverpine Forest, remnants of a corrupted water elemental. Shaman initiates recover them during the Call of Water and cast them into the Brazier of Everfount with pure water to cleanse the shrine and summon a pure water spirit.

The Scourge's plague reached the spirits of Lordaeron. Along Silverpine Forest's misty coast, west of the Sepulcher, a sacred water shrine fell to corruption. Its water manifestation became an aggressive shade. Shaman initiates must defeat it and recover its bracers. At the Brazier of Everfount, they cast the bindings into the flame with pure water, lifting the corruption and calling forth an unblemished water spirit.
